**Data Scientist | Machine Learning | Biostatistics | Healthcare Analytics**
::: {.hero-container} ::: {.hero-left} ![](images/Anuj Ojha_Headshot picture.jpg){width=250px} [📄 CV](files/CV.pdf){.btn-primary target="_blank"} [💼 LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anujojha7){.btn-outline target="_blank"} [📚 Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Y2gF9nEAAAAJ&hl=en){.btn-outline target="_blank"} ::: ::: {.hero-right} ## About Me I am a Data Scientist with over 5 years of experience in data science, biostatistics, and machine learning, specializing in healthcare and biomedical data. During my Ph.D., I worked on developing predictive models and data-driven solutions for cancer research and clinical data analysis. My work focuses on applying machine learning, statistical modeling, and bioinformatics approaches to analyze large-scale biomedical datasets, including RNA-seq and multi-omics data. I have experience building predictive models, performing survival analysis, and developing reproducible data science workflows using R and Python. Previously, I worked as a Data Analyst at Florida International University, where I analyzed healthcare and COVID-19 datasets, developed dashboards, and conducted geospatial analytics to support healthcare decision-making. I am passionate about leveraging data science and machine learning to solve complex healthcare challenges and improve patient outcomes. ::: ::: ::: {.section-card} ## Research & Professional Interests - Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling - Data Science & Statistical Modeling - Biostatistics & Survival Analysis - Healthcare & Clinical Data Analytics - Cancer Genomics & Precision Medicine - RNA-seq & Multi-omics Data Analysis - Bioinformatics & Computational Biology - Deep Learning for Biomedical Data - Natural Language Processing for Healthcare Data - Data Visualization & Scientific Communication - Reproducible Research & Data Pipelines :::
